cs.t: I was looking for one and I didn't find it. I ended up with Logitech G213. This is not a mechanical keyboard, but it is not a thin one like you have on laptops. I wanted a keyboard that has a palm rest. Most of the mechanical keyboards that were available to me didn't have it. It seems to me that keyboards are created for gamers only. Maybe I was looking at wrong places.
cs.th: Ask HN: Silent Mechanical Keyboards Recommendation

cs.t: A "Logitech G213 Prodigy Gaming Keyboard with RGB". Bought on a whim on sale. Not unhappy with the keyboard itself, but its killer app is being able to tell at a glance, by backlit keys, if my work laptop has accidentally un-hibernated after I've finished work (I work from home).
cs.th: Ask HN: What lesser-known accessories do you use with your computer?
